groups.rationale: Reviewed: trace-schema.json regenerated by generate_schema.exs from current production literals, adding the terminal.viewer_refused gateway/attach reasons and trunk Android display vocabulary already present in source; the trace vocabulary contract and its derivation are unchanged.

Reviewed: porsche-terminal-fleet SSH attach evidence promoted to recorded from a passing run cited in the M6 review, with scenario gaps narrowed to the OpenSSH-client scope; chapter 19 regenerated. Guest journald now selects settings or storage by the evaluating NixOS revision, and managed git-lfs pins the v3.7.1 source its patch targets after the devenv nixpkgs update; volatile guest journals and the managed tool contract are unchanged.
